Scope: Power-sign screening only; not a certification that every graph has been mapped or is eligible for scalar tropical integration

Routing.Numerators: Derive a finite parametric numerator or verified finite scalar components; never discard the numerator or pass negative edge powers
Routing.Products: Integrate connected components separately with valid error propagation
Routing.PositiveScalars: Map the actual native integral to a momentum graph, compare exact U/F and Gamma normalization before sampling
